sentences.en: I've never been an intellectual but I have this look.
sentences.zh: 我虽然不算知识分子，但还是有那么点智力。

sentences.en: He was born in Bejaia, Algeria, to an intellectual family.
sentences.zh: 他出生于阿尔及利亚贝贾亚市的一个知识家庭。

sentences.en: Some ideas are so stupid that only intellectuals believe them.
sentences.zh: 有些想法如此愚蠢，只有知识分子才会相信它们。

senses.zh: 智力的，脑力的；有才智的，聪明的；知识分子的
